correctness.rationale: A complete complement-shadow proof covers all cases. Direct enumeration of all \(2^{20}\) triple systems and a separate dual-shadow enumeration both return \(k(H)=49\) as the unique isomorphism-class optimum with 10 labeled realizations.

originality.rationale: Final published-finding corpus searches on the exact value, forbidden \(K_5^{(3)}\), six-vertex order, and shadow formulation found no matching claim; the current 2026 primary source proves only sufficiently-large-\(n\) extremality, while the closest published-finding corpus six-vertex hypergraph census forbids a different configuration.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact finite benchmark and equality classification for the \(K_5^{(3)}\)-free clique-counting problem at \(n=6\), directly complementing the current eventual theorem and the general Frankl-Gryaznov-Talebanfard conjectural framework.
